Add plus and 00 Arabic-Indic and at least one other non-Latin decimal set, with 6/7/15/16-digit and embedding boundaries, to the registry, cases, privacy graph fixtures and normative inventory.

workPackages.title: Corrected declared-versus-executed normative ledger

workPackages.title: Migration matrix completion

workPackages.doneWhen: Distinct required coordinates have distinct semantic evidence where required; recovery and restoration are distinct transitions; unsupported coordinates remain visible failures.
